title: fix(components,plugin-grid): the row menu asks the action family whether a `visible` gate is declared (objectui#11294)
body:
Fixes #11294
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changed

A related list's row menu now gives the same answer as its toolbar to "is a `visible` gate declared?". An action authored `visible: '   '` shows on the toolbar **and** on the rows, whether the rows reach it through `record_related` or `list_item`.

- **`@object-ui/components`**: `isCustomRowActionVisible` (the data table's row menu) asks `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`, the action family's one definition, instead of its own `pred == null || pred === ''`. A blank `visible` (`''`, whitespace, or an envelope whose `source` is blank) is no gate, so the action shows. It is still reported once through the family's `[blank]` report (ADR-0137 D4). The function takes the object's field definitions as an optional fourth argument and is now exported from the package barrel, next to `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`**: `RowActionMenu`'s twin of `isCustomRowActionVisible` is deleted. Its inline primary buttons, its "⋮" items and its "⋮" guard read the one function from `@object-ui/components`. plugin-grid already depends on `@object-ui/components`, so there is no new dependency edge and no cycle (components does not depend on plugin-grid).
- No third "declared?" test is added, and the toolbar gate (objectui#11244) and the row placement (objectui#11270) are untouched.

**Export change, for the ACCEPT to re-read (as the claim asked):** `@object-ui/components` gains one named export, `isCustomRowActionVisible(action, row, scope, fields?)`. It was already exported from its module by deep path, for tests. plugin-grid's copy was never in its barrel, so nothing public leaves.

## The two definitions, as measured before the change (Zone 2.2)

- The family's: `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate` lives in `@object-ui/components` (`renderers/action/visibility-gate.ts`) as a re-export of core's `hasDeclaredPredicate`. Blank text, whitespace, a blank-`source` envelope and junk are "not declared". It reports each blank once with the context "a declared gate, read as no gate".
- The row menu's: both `isCustomRowActionVisible` bodies returned `true` only for `pred == null || pred === ''`. Anything else went to `evalRowPredicate` with `fallback: false`, so a blank failed closed. The two bodies differed only in plugin-grid's extra `fields` argument.

Old and new row verdicts, measured with a throwaway probe (deleted), row `{ x: 1 }`:

| `visible` | old row verdict | new row verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `'   '` | hidden | shown |
| `''` | shown | shown |
| `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '' }` | hidden | shown |
| `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '   ' }` | hidden | shown |
| `0`, `{}`, `[]` (not a predicate) | hidden | shown |
| `false` | hidden | hidden |
| `true`, `'record.x == 1'` | shown | shown |

The junk row moves too. That is the family's rule ("fail-open on junk"), and the changesets say so.

## The `[blank]` report (Zone 2.4)

Measured on the base through the real block: the toolbar reported `'   '` and `''` once each, through the family's channel. The row path reported `'   '` once per action, labelled with the action name, on the fail-closed route. It said nothing for `''`. After the change, the row path reports through the same family channel as the toolbar. That channel is deduplicated per blank spelling across the app, so the report is not repeated per row or per render. The pin below shows this with a blank used only on the rows (two rows, one report). The dedupe is per blank spelling, not per action: two actions with the same blank spelling give one line, as on the toolbar. That is the documented price of core's fixed locator, and this PR leaves it as it is.

## Pins

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RelatedRecordActionsBridge.blankVisible-11294.test.tsx`: the card's table through the real `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`, the `record:related_list` node through the real `SchemaRenderer`, plugin-detail's registration, the real `RelatedList` and the real data table, at desktop width. The toolbar shows `blank_rr`, `blank_li`, `empty_rr` and `empty_li`. The opened row menu shows the same four beside the ungated `send_reminder` control. `never_li` (`visible: false`) stays hidden on both. CEL gates are evaluated against the row: `cel_yes_rr` shows and `cel_no_rr` does not. A rows-only blank is reported exactly once.
- `packages/components/.../data-table-row-action-visible.test.tsx`: the item and the `planDataTableRowMenu` guard, for whitespace, a whitespace-`source` envelope and an empty-`source` envelope.
- `packages/plugin-grid/.../RowActionMenu.test.tsx`: the inline primary button, the "⋮" guard (the action is alone on the row, so the trigger exists only if the guard counted it) and the "⋮" item.
- `predicate-surface-parity.test.tsx` now imports the function from `@object-ui/components`. Its cases are unchanged.

## Evidence

All test commands ran from the repo root through `os-verify-lock.sh`. The reruns are at head `cb23049281`.

- **Red before (Zone 2.1):** at base `caa0cd3927`, the new real-block pin failed with `expected [ 'send_reminder', 'empty_rr', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'send_reminder', 'blank_rr', …(4) ]`: `blank_rr` and `blank_li` were absent from the row menu. The toolbar assertion passed. This reproduces the card's table on current main.
- **Ablation** (`ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode): the shared helper's `if (!hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(pred)) return true;` was swapped back to the old test, `anchor 1 -> 0, blob de5ae999a55b -> 5564ded0538a`. Result: `Tests 10 failed | 30 passed (40)`. All 10 new cases were red, across the three pin files. plugin-grid's pins went red from a mutation in `@object-ui/components` alone, which shows that plugin-grid reads the one function. Then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (de5ae999a55b) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- **Reverse type check:** a fifth argument in plugin-grid's guard call made `tsc` fail with `error TS2554: Expected 3-4 arguments, but got 5.`, so plugin-grid reads the rebuilt `.d.ts`. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- Build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build` exited 0. `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` exited 0.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` each ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` with exit 0. `--listFiles` shows that each test program reads the touched test files.
- Tests:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/renderers/complex/ packages/plugin-grid/`: `Test Files 199 passed (199)`, `Tests 1794 passed (1794)`.
  - `packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 228 passed | 1 skipped (229)`, `Tests 2270 passed | 8 skipped (2278)`.
  - Every other suite that `git grep -l` finds for `isCustomRowActionVisible` or `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`, plus the objectui#11270 bridge suite: `Test Files 13 passed (13)`, `Tests 262 passed (262)`.
- Repo checks, all exit 0:
  - `check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
  - `check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `7 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)`.
  - `changeset:check`: no `major`.
  - `check:control-bytes`: OK.
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:action-forward-parity` also passed.
- **Lint, a declared narrowing.** CI's `Lint` job owns the full run. Here `eslint --format json` ran on the 7 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files: `files 7 errors 0 warnings 67`. ① The population was read from eslint's own config: `eslint --print-config` resolves a config for each of the 7, so none is ignored. ② The file count, 7, comes from the JSON output. ③ Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file from disk. So this diff cannot move the verdict for any file it does not touch. Against the base, the same 6 pre-existing files went from 68 warnings to 67; the 7th is the new pin file, with none. Net change −1 warning and 0 errors: +1 `no-explicit-any` in the new guard pin, −2 in `RowActionMenu.tsx` with the twin removed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, left as it is (for the objectui#3812 declared-gate close-out).** The grid's selection bar still answers "declared?" with its own `!= null && !== ''`: plugin-grid's `bulkEligibility` `hasVisibilityGate`, with core's `partitionRowsByPredicate` opening the same way. Measured through the real `BulkActionBar` with one selected row: `visible: '   '` and a whitespace-`source` envelope hide the bulk button, while `''` and an ungated def show it. The row kebab now shows all four. So for a whitespace `visible`, the bar is now the one surface that disagrees with the toolbars and the rows. Before this PR it agreed with the rows and disagreed with the toolbars. The objectui#3521 parity table therefore still has no whitespace row. This PR does not touch the bulk files, which are outside this card's surface.
- The built-in Edit/Delete `visibleWhen` keeps its `!= null` rule on both row menus. Read at source and not measured: the record header's Edit/Delete (`RecordDetailView`, `useRowPredicate` with `fallback: false`) also hide on a blank, so no surface appears to disagree there. It is a field-rule key under ADR-0137, outside this card's family.
